content: We have applied templates in order: 20810, 2895, 1914397, 1914398, 1914399. Need at least 6 reactions, and also template 74054 must be used last (since order given). So we need one more reaction using template 74054 applied to the product of previous step? The final target is the original SMILES. We have been working backwards: each apply_template gives precursors for the given molecule. So we need to construct a retrosynthesis tree where each reaction node uses the given template and its children are the precursors. We have 5 reactions so far; need a 6th using template 74054. We need to apply template 74054 to one of the precursors from the last step (or maybe to the original target? but order must be as given). The order: first template 20810 applied to target gives two precursors: (precursor1, precursor2). Then template 2895 applied to precursor1? Actually we applied 2895 to the first precursor from 20810 result: that was "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Good. Then 1914397 applied to that gives two precursors: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". Then 1914398 applied to the second of those gave "BrBr" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". Then 1914399 applied to that gave "O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21". So after 1914399 we have a single precursor. Need to apply template 74054 to that precursor to get final precursors (maybe simple). Let's apply template 74054 to "O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21".
